findings.message: Mesh "M_Mask_Eyebrows_Mesh.000" in "male/TropicalMask.glb" contains the reserved token "_eyebrows", which is reserved for facial-feature wearables. Rename the mesh.
findings.fix: Rename the material that shows skin to exactly 'AvatarSkin_MAT' so the engine can tint it. Avoid reserved mesh-name patterns (_mouth, _eyebrows, _eyes) on non-facial items.
